periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the primary axis angled approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid geometry where the longitudinal axis is approximately 1.4 times the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering resulting in a teardrop-like appearance at the inferior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior curve with a relatively flat profile across the midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness across the lateral flanks, occupying approximately 30 percent of the visible dorsal torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation approximately equivalent to two horizontal ear widths.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High degree of smooth, semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.
